spec.model_rule: expanding-window-v1; outcomes available before candidate only
spec.entry: first marketable observed quote no later than 5m after decision
spec.exit: fixed 72h marketable observed quote; no oracle exit
spec.cost_model: observed fee, spread, depth, slippage and latency; +50% stress
spec.sizing: fixed 1 percent opening equity per independent event
spec.risk: max 3 percent gross exposure; 15 percent MaxDD halt
spec.GO: lower95 net and incremental vs best baseline >0; PF>1.10; MaxDD<=15%; coverage and delivery>=99%; survives +50% cost stress
spec.NO_GO: upper95 net or incremental <=0, or stressed upper95 <=0
spec.INCONCLUSIVE: all other outcomes or fewer than 60 independent events by day 365
